blocks.text: DASMARINAS, Cavite—Converge moved closer to securing its first-ever semis berth after defeating Rain or Shine, 105-89, on Tuesday for a 2-1 lead in their PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series here. Juan Gomez de Liano put on the finishing touches with 19 points, 13 rebounds and six assists as the FiberXers defeated the Elasto Painters for the second straight time and closed in on securing the best-of-five series. But it was not just Gomez de Liano who delivered as Calvin Abueva and Jonnel Policarpio provided the intangibles on both ends that enabled Converge to take down Rain or Shine despite a 64-56 […]...
